mainEntity.name: What car body parts does Patel Motors manufacture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Patel Motors manufactures a complete range of car body parts including doors (left and right), bumpers (front and rear), mudguards, fenders, chassis, havabari, pillars, and glass for vehicles like Bolero, Swift, Mahindra, Eicher, Tata, and Hyundai.

mainEntity.name: Do you ship car parts across India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we provide fast delivery across India. Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days within Gujarat and 5-7 business days for pan-India delivery. Express delivery options are also available.

mainEntity.name: What is the warranty on car body parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: We provide a comprehensive 2-year warranty on all manufactured parts covering manufacturing defects, material quality issues, and premature wear under normal usage conditions.

mainEntity.name: How can I order Bolero or Swift parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can order by calling +91 9328629936, emailing patel.motors.7860@gmail.com, or visiting our facility in Mahi, Gujarat. We also accept WhatsApp orders for quick inquiries.
